objectives.name: Find Acropolis, The City Floating Above The Sea

title: The Storm Empress
description:
Name: [Scylla](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/scylla.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Acropolis, a city found floating above oceans.
Estimated Size: Medium
Behavior: Summoned through usage of her anchor, it also acts as her primary weapon for melee attacks and pulling the opponent closer from a distance. Her primary method of attack uses electricity, something that grows stronger when the opponent is [wet](image:cataclysm:textures/mob_effect/wetness.png:50:50). She can create waves that make the opponent wet and throw Lightning Spears from the air. She can also summon magical serpents and conjure a thunderstorm.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
